items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:33:1
items.html: The Otiot of ZON are SATNZ GT It implies to BehinaDalet that mixed in their Kelim. This mixture is called SATNZ, which are the Sigim(Ohr Pnimi item 2), and the GT implies the Nitzotzin that descended to revive the Kelim.
